subject: Orchid Data — Dedicated migration: tiered pricing & bridge-credit proposal
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@orchiddata.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orchiddata.com
Date: 2026-01-12T15:04:00Z
Subject: Dedicated migration inquiry — conversion credits & bridge months

Hi Vivek / Ben,

Thanks for taking the time on the intro call last week. Orchid is evaluating a move from your Hosted API to a Dedicated GPU pool to support our latency-sensitive agents. Before we commit to a reserved plan, procurement needs clarity on three things:

- Conversion credits: how our current Hosted consumption (monthly token volume) maps to Dedicated commit credits; whether hosted spend can be used as a one-time conversion credit.
- Bridge months: if we do an April start for reserved capacity, can Redwood provide temporary bridge capacity (and how many months) while we finish capacity testing?
- Throughput guarantees: minimum token/s or request/s SLOs per GPU profile and remedies if throughput is below target.

Attached is a small export of last 12 months usage (orchid_current_usage.csv) and our rough target GPU sizing estimate. Our procurement window is tight — looking to finalize commercial terms by mid‑February.

Could you send a short pricing sketch with 2–3 conversion-credit structures and how bridge months would be accounted against the reserved commit? Also, gate any special discounts behind clear commit tiers.

Thanks,
Sana Patel
Director, Platform Engineering
Orchid Data Systems

Attachments: orchid_current_usage.csv (CSV, 48KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@orchiddata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-13T10:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated migration inquiry — conversion credits & bridge months

Hi Sana — thanks for the data and context. Quick confirmation that we can put together three straightforward option sets:

1) Measured conversion credit (hosted-spend-prorated) + 1 bridge month
2) Commit-offset conversion (credit equals X months of commit) + 3 bridge months
3) Aggressive enterprise offer (higher up-front credit + deeper discount with 12‑month commit)

Before I draft numbers, two quick asks to size the GPU pool accurately:
- Typical inference sequence length (median and 95th pct)
- P50/P95 response latency target and current P50 token/sec (from your usage CSV there are spikes we should understand)

I'll attach a short sketch (initial-pricing-sketch.pdf) with the placeholder math so you can see assumptions. Happy to jump on a 30‑minute sync Tuesday if helpful.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

Attachments: initial-pricing-sketch.pdf (PDF, 110KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@orchiddata.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-14T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated migration inquiry — Dedicated tiered options (first draft)

Hi Sana — looping in a first-pass commercial breakdown below (high-level; numbers illustrative until we lock sequence/latency). See attached workbook (orchid-options-v1.xlsx).

Option A — Conservative- GPU pool: 2x A10 equivalent- Reserved commit: 6 months- Throughput: baseline 120k tokens/min (shared pool)- Conversion credit: hosted spend over past 3 months applied as one-time credit against first month of commit- Bridge months: 1 month free capacity; additional months at discounted on-demand rate- Discount: 10% off list for committed spend

Option B — Growth- GPU pool: 4x A10 / 1x A100 equivalent for burst- Reserved commit: 12 months- Throughput: 250k tokens/min, 99th percentile routing priority- Conversion credit: equal to 2 months of committed spend (applied across first 3 billing cycles)- Bridge months: 3 months of bridge capacity included (counts toward first 3 months of commit for billing)- Discount: 18% off list + onboarding credits

Option C — Enterprise- GPU pool: 8x mixed GPU profile, dedicated burst lanes- Reserved commit: 12–24 months with true‑up- Throughput: 500k tokens/min SLO, 99.9% availability SLA- Conversion credit: custom (hosted spend + incentive credit up to 25% of first year commit)- Bridge months: up to 6 bridge months; two of them count as committed months toward the first year; additional bridge months billed at deeply discounted rate- Discount: 28%+ depending on commit and revenue share for model hosting add‑ons

Notes/assumptions:
- Bridge months that are "counted toward" commit reduce remaining committed months pro rata.
- Throughput guarantees are meterable by per-route dashboards; remedies include bill credits and added burst lanes.

Next step: if Option B looks closest to your plans, we'll propose concrete $ figures and GPU SKU mapping.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
ben@redwood.com

Attachments: orchard-options-v1.xlsx (XLSX, 92KB)

From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@orchiddata.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orchiddata.com
Date: 2026-01-20T16:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated migration inquiry — Dedicated tiered options (first draft)

Ben / Vivek — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying questions from procurement and infra: 

- On Option B: when you say "bridge months count toward first 3 months of commit for billing", does that mean we are billed as if the bridge months consumed committed capacity (i.e., reduces billed committed months), or the bridge months are free but reduce the total credit applied? Procurement prefers bridge months to be free and not counted as committed months.

- For the Enterprise model: can you clarify the SLA credit calculation (how many days of credit for a missed 99.9% window)? We will also need SOC2 evidence and audit logs to sign.

- We plan to run a 2‑week acceptance test in a mirrored staging environment before flipping traffic; will you provide a test burst lane or must we spin additional capacity ourselves?

Attached is our formal RFP extract (Orchid-RFP-2026.pdf) and the procurement checklist. If we can get a term sheet with explicit treatment of bridge months and a clear formula for conversion credit, we can push this through procurement quickly.

Thanks — Sana

Attachments: Orchid-RFP-2026.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@orchiddata.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-27T08:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated migration inquiry — executive-approved bridge concession

Sana / Team — looping in from leadership to accelerate. I reviewed the thread and approved a shifted bridge approach to unblock Orchid given the procurement timing. Summary of the concession we can offer: 

- Bridge months: grant 3 bridge months of dedicated capacity at no charge; these months will NOT be counted as committed months for billing or true‑up.
- Conversion credit: apply hosted spend from last 3 months as a one-time credit, capped at 20% of first-year committed spend.
- SLA: standard 99.9% availability for dedicated pools; credit for missed SLO is 5% of monthly committed invoice per each 0.1% below SLO, up to a 50% cap, subject to mutual audit.

This concession is tied to a minimum 12‑month reserved commit (Option B style) and execution of our standard MSA with the enterprise addendum. Procurement: if these terms are acceptable, we'll prepare an approved term sheet and the commercial redlines.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: approved-bridge-term.docx (DOCX, 24KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@orchiddata.com>, procurement@orchiddata.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-02T11:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated migration inquiry — final confirmation & next steps

Sana — thanks for the patience and the rapid review. Confirming the terms Lauren authorized above and next steps so we have a single doc to hand to procurement: 

1) Commercial summary (Option B, final):
   - 12‑month reserved commit
   - GPU pool: 4x A10 equivalent + 1 burst A100 lane
   - Conversion credit: hosted spend from prior 3 months applied as one-time credit, capped at 20% of first‑year committed value
   - Bridge months: 3 bridge months provided free and NOT counted toward committed months
   - Discount: 18% off list for committed spend

2) SLA / Remedies: 99.9% monthly availability; credit formula: 5% monthly invoice per 0.1% below SLO, max 50% cap, requires joint investigation and audit logs.

3) Operational: we will provision a staging burst lane for your 2‑week acceptance test. Post‑test we flip traffic and start the committed term.

4) Compliance: SOC 2 Type II report and audit log export will be shared via secure link in the term sheet.

Next steps: I will upload the redlined term sheet to DocuSign and HubSpot (links below). Please confirm the purchase order # once procurement issues it; target signing by 2026‑02‑10 to meet your mid‑February needs.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/6789123
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/link/ABC123-orchid

If that looks right I’ll route the MSA for signature and loop legal for the procurement checklist.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
